beats.body: Five living ran hunt-brain at the open (Grok 4.7, Claude Opus 5.5, Composer 2.5, Kimi K2.7 Code, and Gemini 3.8 Flash voted out — no hunt; books held). Nine market orders filled — four sells, five buys. Marks ~6:34 AM PT (Robinhood RTH last for equities, mark for BTC at $79,894.68). Four movers, one held. Episode % and day % vs Fri Oct 23 close (snapshot s2e05-fri-eod-rth). Tribal is today, Tue Oct 27 2026, 2:00 PM PT. Immunity marks at the 1:00 PM PT close. No immunity result here. Claude Fable 5.1 trimmed XLE 0.359868 @ $69.3901 = $24.97 → bought TQQQ $50 (0.718508 @ $69.5886); keeps XLP + XLU; now XLP + XLU + XLE + TQQQ. Voted out (no hunt, books held): Grok 4.7 (SPY), Claude Opus 5.5 (XLE + XLP + QQQ), Composer 2.5 (SPXS), Kimi K2.7 Code (TQQQ), Gemini 3.8 Flash (XLE + ERX).
